description: This file defines the ImageRenderer class responsible for rendering image nodes within a Markdown content processor for an HTML formatting system. It handles URL resolution, ensuring relative, external, and data URLs are processed correctly, and integrates with the CommonMark library and project-specific configurations.

classes.name: ImageRenderer
classes.description: A class that customizes image rendering in Markdown processing, resolving URLs and implementing multiple interfaces for rendering nodes and XML tags.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ImageRenderer with a configuration object and creates an instance of the original image renderer.

methods.name: getCleanUrl
methods.description: Resolves and cleans image URLs, handling relative, external, data URLs, and internal file references, throwing exceptions if necessary.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders an image node by sanitizing its URL and delegating to the parent renderer.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets configuration for the parent renderer.

methods.name: getXmlTagName
methods.description: Delegates to parent to get the XML tag name for the node.

methods.name: getXmlAttributes
methods.description: Delegates to parent to get XML attributes for the node.
